records.name: Craft Agents
records.tagline: The world's most powerful agents, with the UX they deserve
records.description: Craft Agents is fully open source and runs locally on your machine — your data and keys never leave it. Bring any AI provider: Claude, GPT, Gemini, or local models. Agents connect to your real tools (MCP, APIs, local files) and act across all of them. Code diffs, data tables, diagrams, and live previews render inline. Turn results into persistent Pages, teach reusable Skills, and run Automations on a schedule — all in a desktop UX you can actually live in.

records.name: NitroStack
records.tagline: Build, test, and deploy MCP servers in one place
records.description: NitroStack is the full-stack platform for building production-ready MCP servers and AI apps. Build with open-source TypeScript & Python SDKs, test and debug visually in NitroStack Studio, orchestrate agent workflows with NitroStack Workflow, deploy on NitroStack Cloud, and ship branded experiences with NitroStack Chat. Auth, testing, deployment and frontend stay in one workflow. Connect to ChatGPT, Claude and other AI clients. Powering 80,000+ MCP servers.

records.name: Train with Pasta
records.tagline: A personal trainer powered by Apple Intelligence
records.description: Pasta is a personal trainer in your pocket. Ask for "a 30 minute upper body workout", and it'll build it for you. While you train, the app uses voice as a guide, so you can focus on pushing yourself hard. It does plans too! Tell it what you're training for and it writes a plan around the days you can train. The app runs on Apple Intelligence and needs no account. Your progress and health data stays on your device. Requires an iPhone with Apple Intelligence on iOS 27.

records.name: Earnote
records.tagline: Lecture & meeting notes, written on your device
records.description: Record a lecture, meeting or your own explanation – Earnote transcribes it with Whisper and writes a structured note with tasks, flashcards and a PDF study sheet. Speech recognition runs on your iPhone, iPad or Mac, and on iPhone 15 Pro and later even the note is written on-device. No account, no ads, no subscription. Free and open source (MIT); optional one-time Pro on iPhone/iPad.

records.name: Ultracite v8
records.tagline: The linter and formatter for agentic development
records.description: Agents write most of the code now. Ultracite is the linter and formatter for agentic development, a zero-config preset for Oxlint, Biome, and ESLint that keeps agent-written code consistent and type-safe. Ultracite checks every edit agents make against hundreds of strict rules in under half a second, so what reaches review is consistent, type-safe code instead of slop. Used by engineering teams at OpenAI, Vercel, Mintlify, and thousands of open source projects: ultracite.ai

records.name: Unfenced
records.tagline: Land for sale that actually borders public land
records.description: Checks ~700,000 U.S. listings every week against official public-land maps and shows the ~13,600 homes and land parcels that actually touch national forest, BLM and state land. Each one is measured from its county parcel boundary: the shared edge in feet, drawn on a map, plus how much public land is behind it, elevation, road access, flood zone and wildfire hazard. Search by ZIP or state. Free, no account needed.

records.name: Notion: Context for your agents
records.tagline: Switch AI agents without re-explaining your work
records.description: Notion 3.8 turns your workspace into the shared context layer for every AI agent your team uses. Unlike chat tools that start from zero each time you switch models, Notion keeps your docs, databases, and Skills in one place any MCP agent can read and update. Connect Claude, ChatGPT, or any MCP agent, plug Notion Agents into 150+ tools, sync Skills everywhere with the new Skills API, and see every agent edit in upgraded version history. Plus column permissions and rebuilt synced databases.

records.name: Parrot
records.tagline: Smart Meeting Assistant for Mac that helps during the call
records.description: Parrot is a free, open-source meeting recorder for Mac that helps during the call, not after it. No bot joins: it records what your Mac hears and transcribes on device. When a client asks something your pricing sheet or FAQ covers, the answer appears with the file it came from. After the call you get a report of promises made and questions missed, and you can chat with all your meetings. Use Claude, a free local model with Ollama, or your own server. No account, no subscription.

records.name: Emochi
records.tagline: Voice journal to understand yourself through art and science
records.description: Emochi turns your voice notes into a living, generative character that reflects your emotional world. Vent about your day, untangle a thought, or check in with yourself. Your words are transcribed instantly, helping you notice patterns in how you feel. Built by a doctor, a designer, and two AI engineers, Emochi brings affective science and playful art to private, non-clinical self-reflection. Start with a voice note. Meet your Mochi.

records.name: Caldera
records.tagline: Your Obsidian vault as a living profile and linked garden
records.description: Caldera turns your Obsidian vault into a public page that updates itself, and a digital garden of notes you grow in public. Plant a note and it becomes a page marked seedling, budding or evergreen, with a license you choose. Link to a note in a friend's garden and the backlink appears on theirs. Private by default: nothing leaves your vault unless you choose it, and contact details are stripped. Free, open source and self-hostable.

records.name: Spiralens
records.tagline: Golden ratio camera that tells you where to move your phone
records.description: Spiralens is an Android camera for people who never learned composition. Tap your subject, follow the arrow, and shoot when the ring turns green: the subject sits on the golden point and the phone is level. Guides for golden spiral, phi grid, rule of thirds, symmetry and horizon. The editor adds a golden-ratio crop, straighten, drag-to-crop and a new background blur that keeps your target sharp. Works offline; photos never leave your phone.

records.name: GPU Terminal by Context.dev
records.tagline: Compare GPU rental prices across cloud providers
records.description: GPU cloud pricing is scattered across dozens of providers. GPU Terminal brings recent hourly rates into one dashboard. Pick your GPU, compare provider offers, explore price history, and check original sources. Open source and built by Context.dev.

records.name: LooGo
records.tagline: Find public restrooms fast
records.description: LooGo helps you find public restrooms instantly when you're out in the city. Built natively for Android and Wear OS using OpenStreetMap data, it gives you quick access to door codes, pricing, opening hours, and accessibility details. No ads, no tracking, and no bloat just fast offline maps and a companion Wear OS app so you can find a spot directly from your wrist.

records.name: Draper
records.tagline: Validate, plan, and launch a business, one step at a time.
records.description: Turn your idea into a real product. Use Draper to find out if your idea holds up, and then work through the next steps: business plan, brand, product, landing page, first customers — all in one place.

records.name: CrewTower Mod for Claude Code
records.tagline: Talk to Claude Code right from your MacBook notch
records.description: A Claude Code mod that links every Claude session to CrewTower in your Mac's notch. Type Claude's next prompt on its card, stop the turn, compact it, and see what fills its context. Terminal and Claude Desktop. Stays on your Mac, off until you turn it on.

records.name: Salience
records.tagline: See every request to your website and how it responds.
records.description: Salience turns the server and CDN data you already generate into a live view of every request, response and issue, from people, search engines and AI bots.

records.name: Korinotch
records.tagline: Your MacBook notch, turned into a command center
records.description: Media HUD, notifications, file tray, clipboard, keep awake, keyboard lock and widgets, all in the notch. Native SwiftUI for macOS 14+. Free for 14 days, then $11.50 lifetime. Eleven of the utilities are free standalone menu-bar apps.

records.name: Step 5 Preview
records.tagline: 600B open weights, trained for long-running agents
records.description: Step 5 Preview is StepFun's open-weight MoE for coding, financial research and long-running agents. It has 600B total parameters, 27B active per token and a 1M-token context, with deployment support for vLLM, SGLang and Transformers.

records.name: Butla
records.tagline: Your AI butler for everyday life. Live on your terms
records.description: Your AI butler for everyday life. Acts on your behalf, coordinates & keeps your day organized, handles tasks across work and home, and catches what you'd miss. Learns how you live: your routines and preferences to get things done your way. Talk to your butler to research, create, coordinate, book, and buy, with your approval where it matters. Now open to everyone.

records.name: Tesla Wrap Pro
records.tagline: Explore a gallery of digital Tesla wraps and create design
records.description: Find a digital wrap for your Tesla's on-screen car. Browse the gallery by model, explore designs, and download available wraps. Make your own with the browser editor and 3D preview. Optional AI generation uses paid credits.

records.name: LLMGrid
records.tagline: The Unified LLM Gateway
records.description: LLMGrid is a unified AI gateway connecting multiple LLM providers through one API. Bring your own keys for OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Groq, Mistral, and more. Route requests, configure automatic fallbacks, switch models seamlessly, create virtual API keys, and manage access and budgets. Monitor usage, costs, latency, and logs from one dashboard without provider lock-in. **Get started for free and scale as you grow.**

records.name: Codeck
records.tagline: Switch between Codex and Claude Code tasks on your Mac
records.description: Stop hunting through windows for your coding agents. Codeck puts Codex and Claude Code tasks in one Mac keyboard switcher, shows task status, and lets you type or dictate new tasks from anywhere. $5 once, plus tax. No subscription.

records.name: 9to4
records.tagline: A daily picture quiz: 9 photos, pick the 4 that fit
records.description: 9 real photos, 1 question: "Which 4 of these castles are in Spain?" or "Which 4 peaks are over 5,000 m?" Pick the right 4. The catch: the wrong ones are close calls, like castles from neighbouring countries. Castles, aircraft, vehicles, peaks and islands, all real and credited to their photographers on Wikimedia Commons. Play the free Daily (same round for everyone, streaks, shareable result) or go Endless, and collect every find in your album. No sign-up needed.

records.name: Echo Agent
records.tagline: Your service business's second-in-command
records.description: Echo runs the admin for plumbers, electricians, physios, salons and every service business, from WhatsApp. Send a voice note and get an itemised quote or an invoice with a payment link back in about 30 seconds. Customers book and pay 24/7 from your booking page, with Google/Outlook sync and automatic reminders. Then Echo grows the business: about 3 social posts a week (you approve each), review requests and a Find a pro listing. Free plan, no card needed.

records.name: UGCdrop - Text Hook Library
records.tagline: Hooks that already went viral, ready to reuse
records.description: The first second decides if anyone keeps watching. Hook Library collects hooks that already went viral. Search for your niche, save the ones that fit, copy them, or send them straight into Studio. Browse as many as you want.

records.name: Debutly
records.tagline: Your $10k launch video, made by AI in minutes
records.description: Most AI video tools hand you an editor and leave the hard part to you. Debutly is different: it works like a video agency, not a tool. Paste your website link, add a few screenshots, and get back a finished, agency-quality product video. No timelines, no editing. It makes launches, feature updates, demos, ads, and website videos, in every format. And when you ship something new, Debutly automatically drafts your next update video. Built for SaaS teams who'd rather ship than edit.

records.name: London's Million Pixel Sphere
records.tagline: Your Next Advetisement Gaming Platform
records.description: Buy from the 1 million pixels on a rotating 3D sphere for £1 each. The more pixels you own, the more visibility on the sphere. The sphere is part of an interactive and addictive multiplayer game, at the end of each game, players will see your business ad, the probability of them seeing your ad is dependent on the amount of pixels you have purchased. As our player base increases with our social media campaign, the likelihood of your business receiving attention through our game increases.

records.name: OraFlow
records.tagline: Dental practice management, all in one place
records.description: OraFlow is an all-in-one practice management platform built for independent dentists and multi-branch dental clinics. Manage appointments, patient records, interactive 2D dental charts, treatment plans, X-rays and dental images, billing, financial analytics, staff schedules, and online booking links in one place. Built-in Second Opinion tools help dental professionals collaborate. Manage your practice with one connected platform.

records.name: clAIssified
records.tagline: Don’t archive your side project — sell it
records.description: Marketplace for finished and half-finished AI tools and micro-SaaS. Sellers list for a one-time price, buyers pay into escrow, and the money is released after a verified handover. Buyers can ask sellers anything — no sign-up needed.

records.name: Unforgettable Car AI
records.tagline: Give your dream car an AI entrance from a selfie
records.description: Give your car a cinematic entrance. Unforgettable Car AI turns a selfie and a car photo into the Unforgettable car trend: flash the 2 and 4 cards, swipe the lens, and reveal your ride. Use your own car or pick a coupe, supercar, or SUV, then choose a night scene. Create a 15-second, 720p landscape MP4 without prompts or editing. Videos are silent so you can add music when posting.

records.name: OptimAI Studio
records.tagline: Your AI creative agent, from idea to final cut
records.description: Turn an idea into a connected creative project. Direct an AI agent to plan films, generate images, video and music, then refine them in a browser editor. Create illustrated stories, publish websites and build playable games—all in OptimAI Studio.

records.name: Why Is Italian Cuisine So Popular?
records.tagline: Why Is Italian Cuisine So Popular?
records.description: Italian cuisine is loved around the world for its fresh ingredients, simple cooking methods, and rich flavours. From classic pizzas and creamy pasta to risotto and traditional desserts, Italian food offers something for different tastes.

records.name: GPU Terminal by Context.dev
records.tagline: Compare GPU rental prices across cloud providers
records.description: GPU cloud pricing is scattered across dozens of providers. GPU Terminal brings recent hourly rates into one dashboard. Pick your GPU, compare provider offers, explore price history, and check original sources. Open source and built by Context.dev.

records.name: Leepik
records.tagline: Bank PDFs to Tally, with ledger mapping that learns
records.description: Turn bank-statement PDFs into Tally-ready accounting entries. Built for Indian accountants. Open beta: anyone can join, with all features free throughout beta. Leepik learns your ledger choices, reducing repeat work each month. Review balance checks and ledger suggestions, then export Tally XML or CSV. Statements are processed on Leepik's own servers, never sent to third-party AI or OCR services. Text-based PDFs only; scanned PDFs aren't supported.

records.name: LooGo
records.tagline: Find public restrooms fast
records.description: LooGo helps you find public restrooms instantly when you're out in the city. Built natively for Android and Wear OS using OpenStreetMap data, it gives you quick access to door codes, pricing, opening hours, and accessibility details. No ads, no tracking, and no bloat just fast offline maps and a companion Wear OS app so you can find a spot directly from your wrist.

records.name: WordNet Explorer
records.tagline: See how words relate, by meaning and by real-world usage
records.description: WordNet Explorer is a visual NLP toolkit for English words. Explore synsets and relations, analyze text, map semantic networks, and compare words by meaning (WordNet) and real-world usage (embeddings), with a plain-English verdict. Free JSON API included.

records.name: Madevisa GhostGood
records.tagline: Roast the companies that ghost you. Find ones that reply.
records.description: Applied and heard nothing? Make it count. 👻 GhostGood lets job seekers share how a company handled their application — reply, rejection, interview or silence — in 20 seconds, privately. Reports add up to a public reply score per company, so the next person knows who answers. It sits on MadeVisa: 100,000+ live jobs from employers’ own career pages, visa sponsorship marked, and CV matching that shows how well you fit before you apply.

records.name: Roomy
records.tagline: Your Mac's storage, cleaned up on autopilot
records.description: Roomy maps everything taking up space on your Mac and shows what's safe to remove. Then Autopilot keeps it tidy on its own: every day it clears caches of apps you're not using, old installers, forgotten Trash and bloated developer caches, and it steps in when your disk is almost full. It never touches your photos or documents. Not sure what a folder is? Right-click it and ask "What is this?". Free to try, $6.99 once for Pro. No subscription.

records.name: GenClean.site
records.tagline: Private image tools and screenshot studio. No uploads.
records.description: GenClean combines private image tools with a screenshot studio. Convert, resize, compress, remove metadata, create browser and device mockups, and bulk rename files without uploading your images. Style screenshots with backgrounds, text, and animation in GenClean Studio. Single-file tools are free, with no account required. Pro unlocks supported batch workflows and ZIP export for a one-time $9.

records.name: croc-app
records.tagline: Android client for croc with a modern, mobile-first UI
records.description: croc-app is an Android client for croc with a modern, mobile-first UI built in Kotlin and Jetpack Compose. It is designed to make file and text sharing feel much more natural on Android: quick send, quick receive, QR-assisted flows, saved codes, transfer history, and better handling for the small details that matter on phones.

records.name: GhostSovereign
records.tagline: Local-first privacy and security tools for Windows
records.description: GhostSovereign brings together Windows tools for file protection, Defender scans, evidence records, data control, and authorized network visibility. Built by solo developer Dakota D Garrett at GhostHaven Technologies with a local-first privacy philosophy. One-time purchase with lifetime access; no subscriptions.

records.name: WonderKit
records.tagline: AI trip planner your whole group can vote on
records.description: Group trips die in the group chat. WonderKit drafts day-by-day itineraries in seconds. Open any place in your plan and it's checked against live Google Maps data, marked Verified when it matches. Share one link: your crew votes on activities and stays, and the plan settles itself. It learns your travel style, surfaces events this week, and shows stays with live rates. Try it with no account. PH folks: code PRODUCTHUNT takes $20 off any plan, a free first month on monthly.

records.name: 100kb-sdk
records.tagline: Client-side WebAssembly image & PDF optimizer.
records.description: 100kb-sdk is a client-side WebAssembly image & PDF optimizer for React, Next.js, and HTML. Instead of paying Cloudinary $99/mo, it compresses files 100% in browser RAM in ~25ms before S3 upload. Key Features: • Exact target-KB bisection (e.g. 50KB, 100KB) • Bypasses Vercel's 4.5MB payload limit • 100% GDPR compliant (files never leave device) • Cuts AWS S3 and Lambda costs by 85% • Includes <100kb-uploader> Web Component Free on npm with optional white-label license.

records.name: Lam Rimba
records.tagline: Care for the Wildlife Keep the Forest Alive
records.description: Most games ask you to fight nature. Lam Rimba asks you to protect it An indie browser based conservation adventure inspired by Indonesia's rainforests. Explore tropical habitats, photograph wildlife, complete forest patrol missions and discover species in the Rimba Dex Built by a solo developer to make wildlife conservation feel like an adventure, not a lecture. Free to play, with optional ways to support its development

records.name: Feedrion
records.tagline: Follow everything that matters, spoiler-free
records.description: Feedrion is the RSS reader that follows more than websites. Keep your feeds, newsletters, YouTube, TV shows, weather and currencies in one place, with anti-spoil masking that hides the names you never want to see. Offline sync, AI summaries and translations (or bring your own key, which never touches our server), audio reading. On Android, web and Wear OS. Free to use, with optional Premium from €2.99/month. Try the demo, no account: feedrion.com/demo

records.name: metaNESTA
records.tagline: Turn any AI chat into a post, quiz, or course.
records.description: metaNESTA is a free learning community with a built-in AI tutor, Maverick. Ask anything, then turn the answer into a post, quiz, or full learning journey in one tap. Take free journeys on nursing, EMS, tech and more, or start a study group for your class.

records.name: PCMonitor v1.3
records.tagline: Windows monitoring with detachable widgets and floating HUDs
records.description: PCMonitor v1.3 monitors CPU, GPU, RAM, VRAM, disk, battery, network and disk I/O on Windows. The redesigned dashboard adds 3D-style panels, live graphs and two themes. Detach individual widgets, or use resizable, lockable Full HUD and temperature HUD views. Includes top processes, TEMP cleanup and system status. Core monitoring works offline. English, Traditional Chinese and Simplified Chinese. Temperature readings depend on sensor support. 7-day trial; one-time purchase, no subscription.

records.name: PhotoSheet Pro: Print Photos at Home
records.tagline: Exact-size photo sheets for home printing(A4,10×15,passport)
records.description: Fit to Page steals millimetres. Your 10×15 comes out wrong. Passport photos get rejected. Ink wasted. PhotoSheet Pro builds exact-size printable sheets for home printers — real mm/inches, not guesswork. • A4, Letter, 4×6 / 10×15 & more • Print-ready PDF @ 300 DPI — print at 100% / Actual Size • Passport Studio (EU, US, CA, CN) with on-device face crop • Photos stay in your browser unless you save a project Try free. No credit card. Upgrade only when you need unlimited exports.

records.name: JotDownThatMovie
records.tagline: Track movies & shows, find where to stream them
records.description: JotDownThatMovie (AnotaCine) is a lightweight watchlist app for movies and TV shows. Save what you want to watch, browse what’s now playing or coming soon, and see which streaming service has a title — in your country, or compare others. Search any title, pull details and trailers from TMDB, and keep your list organized with ratings and notes. No account, no ads, no clutter — just your list and where to watch it. Available in Spanish and English.

records.name: CreatorBoard
records.tagline: Promote your YouTube channel and Instagram profile
records.description: CreatorBoard – Grow Your Audience & Earn Rewards! 🚀 CreatorBoard is a platform for YouTubers, Instagram creators, and influencers to discover creators, improve visibility, explore leaderboards, and earn rewards. 📈 Creator Discovery 🏆 Leaderboards 💰 Referral Rewards: Earn $1 for every successful referral. 🎁 Compete for rewards worth $1,000+ for the Top 10 Creators. 💵 Earn $2–$25 through Circle profile exploration. 🌐 https://creatorboard.lol Discover More. Grow Together. Earn Rewards!

records.name: DeckCraft AI
records.tagline: Turn messy notes or old slides into boardroom-ready decks
records.description: DeckCraft AI turns rough meeting notes, PDFs, or outdated PowerPoint (.pptx) files into polished, boardroom-ready 16:9 presentations in seconds. Unlike AI tools that generate scrollable web pages that break when exported, DeckCraft designs real widescreen slides that never cut off your text. Choose "Preserved Mode" to redesign existing slides without changing a single word, or "Enhanced Mode" to turn rough ideas into executive stories.

records.name: OS42 Prompt Operator System
records.tagline: Role-defined AI operators for founders, sellers & agents
records.description: OS42 turns loose prompts into role-defined AI operators: each has a job, defined inputs, step-by-step instructions, an acceptance gate, and a structured output. The Prompt Operator Pack ships 12 operators that run on ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini - no code, no setup. Built for founders, sellers, freelancers and agents who use AI daily. Start free: os42.gumroad.com/l/wuwktp. Full pack $39, or $29 with code LAUNCH29. All 9 packs: the Complete Bundle, $199 or $169 with BUNDLE169.

records.name: Melodic Strings
records.tagline: Play string textures and layer orchestral ideas online
records.description: Sketch a string part without opening a full production session. Choose orchestral-style sounds, play in automatic chord or chromatic modes, and shape the result with effects. Use MIDI input, record and layer parts, and export clips when an arrangement starts to take shape. Melodic Strings is a focused instrument for composers, arrangers and musical exploration. Works in the browser, with free features and optional paid upgrades. Also available on Android.

records.name: FootyMate
records.tagline: Never miss another football match! Calendar and reminders.
records.description: FootyMate makes it easy to keep track of the football team you follow. View upcoming and completed fixtures in a clear, chronological schedule. records.name: Market Structure Pro

Get alerts on screen or by email, even with the chart closed. Try it for 30 minutes with no account, then a free week, then $60 a month.

records.name: PocketCoach

records.name: PacketFlow Lens
records.tagline: Free tcpdump analysis with packet flows and source evidence

records.name: Trucks Compare Tool
records.tagline: Compare Trucks by Price, Mileage, Payload & Features
records.description: Compare trucks side by side on price, engine, power, mileage, and specifications. Pick the right commercial vehicle for your business on TruckOnWheels.

records.name: Lunar Paper Public Beta
records.tagline: 19 apps to plan, create and collaborate on your own server
records.description: Lunar Paper brings 19 apps for planning, content, data, automation and creative work into one self-hosted platform. Most apps support live collaboration, with shared accounts and permissions. Group related work into Services so apps can work together—from forms and workflows to dashboards, documents and design tools. Run it with Docker Compose, connect your own AI providers or leave AI off entirely. The full platform is free for up to three people, with no time limit. Now in public open beta.

records.name: Nuqta Icons
records.tagline: 100K+ icons in 8 styles and 3 corner shapes
records.description: Nuqta Icons is an icon system for designers and developers: 4,185 original designs, each in 8 styles (Stroke, Light, Bold, Filled, Duotone, Twotone, Bulk, Shift) and 3 corner shapes (Rounded, Standard, Sharp). Ship with packages for React, Vue, React Native and Flutter, using the same names. 12,555 Stroke icons are free for commercial use.

records.name: FacelessCast
records.tagline: Type a topic, get a finished faceless video in minutes
records.description: Describe a video in one message and FacelessCast finishes it: a hook-first script, a natural AI voice in 37 languages, moving AI scenes or royalty-free stock footage, and captions synced to the real speech. What's different: you see the plan and its price before anything starts, characters keep the same look and voice across a whole series, and product promos show your real screens, not AI drawings. Ready for Shorts, TikTok, Reels and YouTube, up to 4K.

records.name: ThriftBuddy: Resale Scanner
records.tagline: Scan items in thrift aisles to check active eBay values
records.description: An iOS app for resellers that identifies thrift store items with AI and shows active eBay listings and profit estimates in seconds.

records.name: Vercel Shop
records.tagline: Open-source Shopify storefront built for AI agents
records.description: Vercel Shop is an open-source Next.js storefront template for Shopify, built so people, search engines and AI agents can all shop the same store. records.name: Atonomuse
records.tagline: Your Instagram and Facebook, written and posted for you
records.description: Paste your website. Atonomuse learns how your business talks, then makes image posts, carousels and animated reels for Instagram and Facebook, and publishes them on your schedule. A critic scores every post before it can go out and sends weak ones back to be rewritten. Approve each post from your phone, or let the good ones go out on their own. Free plan: one post and one carousel on your own brand, no card.

records.name: Distl
records.tagline: Distl — The useful part, brought forward.
records.description: Distl is a Chrome extension that turns long articles, emails, AI replies, PDFs, and documents into clear, useful takeaways. Select the text you want to understand, and Distl brings forward the key point, next step, or decision without making you leave the page. It keeps the original context available, so you can move quickly without losing the details that matter. Built for anyone who spends too much time searching through text to find the part worth acting on.

records.name: Wish Generator
records.tagline: Your family in one AI photo card, video or song - on the day
records.description: Tell the agent who the greeting is for and why. It writes the wish, puts your own people into one photo card - even if they live in different countries - turns it into a short video or a song with their name, and sends it on the day. Works in English, Russian, Hebrew and Arabic. New since our first listing: video cards, songs, voice greetings and reminders before the date.

records.name: Signal Studio AI
records.tagline: Turn live market research into viral posts & lead replies
records.description: Stop guessing what to post. Signal Studio AI is the ultimate engine built for founders & creators to turn live market research into contrarian angles, viral posts, and thoughtful lead replies instantly. Why choose us? 🚀 Platform-native content tailored for your audience 🧠 Spot angles that stand out from generic AI noise 📈 Convert inbound leads with smart, structured replies 🔒 Exclusively secured with anti-piracy single-user licensing to protect our premium creators community.

records.name: Unlost
records.tagline: Translate your whole Shopify store, SEO included
records.description: Most Shopify translation apps translate your products and stop there. Unlost translates the whole store: products, collections, pages, menus, SEO titles and meta descriptions, and even the text written into your theme’s code. New and edited products are translated automatically, so every language stays up to date. Add a glossary for brand names, check everything in a review list and show different images per language. Free plan to try, paid plans from $13.99.

records.name: Kenby
records.tagline: Accurate, cited answers from your own knowledge

records.name: PaedDeadSpace
records.tagline: Pediatric Ventilation & Dead Space Simulator
records.description: PaedDeadSpace is a free, open-source tool exploring the impact of apparatus dead space on pediatric ventilation. Unlike conventional calculators, it distinguishes patient from equipment dead space and enables interactive physiological simulations. With transparent, reproducible calculations, offline functionality, and no data collection, it supports medical education and research. Developed by a pediatric anesthesiologist, it is not intended for clinical decision-making.

records.name: Renakin
records.tagline: Construction issues, evidence and ownership, floor by floor
records.description: Explore a construction workflow prototype that connects site observations to floors, areas, evidence, owners, responses and review. This early-stage demo uses fictional sample data, runs in your browser and stores additions only on your device. We welcome feedback from construction professionals and potential pilot partners.

records.name: BudujSprytnie

records.name: Phone Mirror

Open any template and present it without signing up. Export to PowerPoint, PDF or MP4.

records.name: HiDataLinker

Built with Tauri 2 + Rust: cold start under a second, ~90 MB RAM idle. No accounts, no telemetry, no paywall on core features.
